description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Correction notice to the Gaz. Ex. No. 2039/27 of 04.10.2017 in English Version (Horizon College of Business & Technology)
reasoning: This gazette content is a correction notice regarding a printing error in a previous gazette about degree awarding authority for a private educational institution (Horizon College of Business & Technology). It involves educational matters (degree programs and abbreviations) but does not contain government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (4-9) as it is not primarily about land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters.
